statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
Continuous cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic risk
The service is related to diagnoses G45.9 and I34.0
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
